url.description: WebUI base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081 or https://your.domain/qbittorrent

username.description: WebUI username (leave blank if you use "Bypass authentication for clients on localhost")

password.description: WebUI password (stored in plain text by Cinnamon - see README)

max-label-length.description: Panel label width (max torrent name length before truncating)

dropdown-count.description: Torrents to show in the dropdown (in addition to the one in the panel)
